name: Santosh Mallesan
title: Technology Leader innovating with AI/ML; Startups; 33 patents
summary: Technology Executive and Verizon Fellow with 25+ years of progressive engineering leadership, specializing in technology transformation, cloud-native architecture, and commercialization of Applied Research in emerging technologies. Proven track record scaling global engineering organizations (80+), driving architectural modernization in complex SaaS environments, and delivering web-scale platforms for Fortune 500 enterprises. Holder of 33 patents and veteran of a $40M startup exit, with deep expertise bridging R&D and high-revenue commercial products.

strengths.text: Deep expertise in GenAI, LLMs, Computer Vision, and multimodal systems, applying these technologies to Web Scale platforms and Mobile architectures.
Proven ability to build and manage global cross-functional teams of 80+ (US & India), overseeing budgets and large-scale software releases.
Instrumental in scaling a startup from ground zero to $40M in sales, culminating in a successful acquisition.
Prolific inventor with 33 granted patents, adept at identifying patentable IP to create product differentiation and increase corporate value.
Expert in delivering products from inception to maturity (SaaS, Mobile, Cloud), bridging the gap between applied research and commercial deployment.
Delivered solutions across diverse sectors including Telecom, Industry 4.0, HealthAI, Robotics, AR/VR, EdTech, and Public Safety.

bullets.text: Orchestrating sub-agents using LangGraph while coupling with high-performant model routing and guard railing of sensitive enterprise data
bullets.story: The architecture uses LangGraph to orchestrate specialized sub-agents for knowledge extraction and ROI attribution, a custom-built super fast AI Proxy written in Rust, and integrated with industry leading https proxies. The LLM choice is based on query complexity and can be switched between any leading LLM providers or private ones.

experience.summary: I directed strategy for Verizon's innovation portfolio, bridging Product Management and Product Engineering to transition applied research into creating minimum viable products.

bullets.text: Unlocked a $15B market opportunity by architecting and implementing Verizon's UAV connectivity platform; engineered a hybrid CPU/GPU backend for sub-second flight path optimization at scale, while enabling customers to meet the most recent FAA regulations on BvLOS flights.
bullets.story:
New FAA regulations for BVLoS (Beyond Visual Line of Sight) opened a new market opportunity for UAV  (drones, etc) cellular connectivity. UAV communication over cellular connectivty has a line-of-sight interference problem that does not exist in normal terrestrial cellular communication. I led the architecture and implementation of a ML algorithm that utilizes Verizon's proprietary data to predict connection quality along a flight path, and Verizon's UAV connectivity platform, which included a hybrid CPU/GPU backend for flight path optimization. I built a large scale data ingestion pipeline connecting to multiple data sources with different data governance rules. 
I managed a cross-functional team of 5 engineers for implementation and collaborated with 3 different internal organizations to securely access the sensitive data. This platform enabled customers to meet FAA regulations for BvLOS flights and unlocked a $15B market opportunity for Verizon in the UAV space. I deployed the solution in an OpenShift environment, conforming with the existing MLOps CI/CD pipelines and security protocols for the Verizon product cloud (Artifactory, Jenkins, Blackduck, SonarQube and Twistlock).

bullets.text: Led the engineering of a B2C RAG-LLM platform. Built a secure, scalable architecture capable of ingesting and querying private data for tens of millions of customers.
bullets.story:
I led the architecture and engineering of a B2C RAG-LLM platform that can securely ingest and query private data for tens of millions of verizon customers and be utilized for multiple RAG use cases. Working with a team of engineers, I designed the LLM inference architecture based on vLLM and the platform was multi-tenant for different uses cases and supported choices of vector databases and LLMs. The architecture utilized MCP to retrieve chunks from appropriate vector databases. The RAG architecture was designed with a multi-agent approach, with specialized agents for planning, data extraction, use case specific guardrails and human-in-the-loop escape hatches, all orchestrated through a LangGraph framework. The guard rails were implemented using NeMo for user inputs, retrieval chunks and output. I designed in an observability layer that tracks across multiple agents, and providing prompt provenance. 
I deployed the solution in an OpenShift environment, conforming with the existing MLOps CI/CD pipelines and security protocols for the Verizon product cloud (Artifactory, Jenkins, Blackduck, SonarQube and Twistlock).
I collaborated closely with product management to define the product requirements and worked with the security team to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations. This initiative resulted in an internal platform that can be used for multiple RAG use cases across the company, and has the potential to generate significant revenue by enabling personalized AI experiences for Verizon customers.

bullets.text: Drove end-to-end architecture of a scalable, generative AI platform providing in-network, real-time fraud detection, call transcription, and summarization services for voice calls on a cellular network.
bullets.story:
I led the architecture and coordinated the development of a Voice AI platform that enabled multiple genAI use cases for voice calls on a cellular network, including real-time fraud detection, call transcription, and summarization services. The architecture utilized NVIDIA Riva for scalable voice-to-text conversion followed by a parallel services pipeline for multiple genAI features. I colloborated with the models team to develop custom deep learning models for early low-cost fraud detection and fine-tuned LLMs for more nuanced detections. 
I worked closely with product management to refine the use cases and worked with the security team to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations. The platform's scalable architecture allows for the addition of new AI-driven features in the future, positioning Verizon as a leader in innovative voice services.

bullets.text: Spearheaded the R&D strategy for complex robotic operations in large-scale factories. Solved a previously unsolved domain challenge by designing algorithms that normalize indoor location data across diverse robot fleets, predicting path congestion and connectivity anomalies.
bullets.story:
I led the R&D strategy for complex robotic operations in large-scale factories, focusing on solving the challenge of normalizing indoor location data across diverse robot fleets. I designed algorithms that utilize sensor fusion and machine learning to predict path congestion and connectivity anomalies, enabling seamless coordination among heterogeneous robot fleets. I built the data lake architecture to ingest multi-modal sensor data and location data from robot fleets to feed the ML model. This innovation significantly improved operational efficiency and reduced downtime in large factory environments, demonstrating the potential of advanced robotics in Industry 4.0 applications. 
I collaborated with cross-functional teams, including robotics engineers, data scientists, and customer account teams, to implement and validate the solution for real-world environments. This initiative not only enhanced Verizon's capabilities in the industrial IoT space but also positioned the company as a leader in providing innovative solutions for smart factories and automated logistics.

bullets.text: Pioneered a multi-modal 'Aging-in-Place' platform integrating Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI) and robotic sensors (RGBD, IR, Acoustic), utilizing Differential Privacy and Edge-encryption to ensure HIPAA-level security. Led a team of 15, including researchers from a leading university, and designed custom deep learning models for detecting activities of daily living.
bullets.story:
I led the development of a multi-modal 'Aging-in-Place' platform that integrates Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI) and robotic sensors (RGBD, IR, Acoustic) to monitor and assist elderly individuals in their homes. The platform utilizes Differential Privacy and Edge-encryption to ensure HIPAA-level security for sensitive health data. I managed a team of 15 engineers and researchers, including collaborations with a leading university, to design custom deep learning models for detecting activities of daily living (ADLs) such as eating, sleeping, and medication adherence. I tuned the custom models for edge inferencing and optimal usage of cloud and connectivity resources. This innovative solution has the potential to improve the quality of life for elderly individuals by enabling early detection of health issues and providing timely interventions, while also addressing critical privacy concerns in healthcare AI applications.  
This initiative not only advanced Verizon's capabilities in the healthcare AI space but also demonstrated the company's commitment to leveraging technology for social good. An iOS/Swift mobile app was developed for use by caregivers and seniors, while a AngularJS frontend was developed for platform management. I implemented external APIs using GraphQL and internal APIs using gRPC.

bullets.text: Standardized the XR Service Architecture across the enterprise, reducing application time-to-market by 40% through reusable MEC-optimized (Mobile Edge Compute) modules.
bullets.story:
I led a team of subject matter experts to standardize the XR Service Architecture across the enterprise, focusing on reducing application time-to-market for AR/VR solutions. I designed reusable MEC-optimized (Mobile Edge Compute) modules that can be easily integrated into various AR/VR applications, enabling low-latency processing and enhanced user experiences. This standardization effort resulted in a 40% reduction in application development time, allowing Verizon to rapidly deploy innovative AR/VR solutions across multiple industries, including retail, entertainment, and remote collaboration. 
I collaborated closely with product management and engineering teams to ensure the architecture met the needs of different use cases while maintaining scalability and performance.

bullets.text: Led a cross-functional initiative to unify Verizon's computer vision efforts. Designed an API-driven, framework-agnostic inferencing engine, successfully validating the architecture on AWS and demonstrating scalable cloud inference infrastructure.
bullets.story: I led a cross-functional initiative to unify Verizon's computer vision efforts across multiple business units. I designed an API-driven, framework-agnostic inferencing engine that can support various computer vision models and use cases. I built an end-to-end CV platform that supported scalable model training on PyTorch and Tensorflow frameworks, deployment on the inference cloud, with built-in observability layer for model performance and hardware utilization. I successfully validated the architecture on AWS, demonstrating scalable cloud inference infrastructure that can handle high volumes of data and provide low-latency responses. This initiative not only streamlined Verizon's computer vision development but also enabled faster deployment of CV solutions across the enterprise, driving innovation in areas such as smart cities, retail analytics, and public safety. I led the implementation of the platform dashboard utilizing REST APIs (NodeJS) for select functions for automation and the rest using a Angular/Typescript frontend.

bullets.text: Secured 2 patents for novel ML algorithms that utilize smartphone sensors to determine variable floor heights, solving a critical vertical location accuracy challenge for emergency responders. Validated the solution through demonstrations at key industry forums.
bullets.story: I developed novel machine learning algorithms that utilize smartphone sensors to determine variable floor heights, addressing a critical vertical location accuracy challenge for emergency responders in multi-story buildings. This technology significantly enhances the ability of first responders to locate individuals in need of assistance during emergencies. I used a crowd-sourcing technique to predict variable floor heights in high-rise structures. I mentored of team of 4 junior engineers during this project. I secured 2 patents for this innovation and validated the solution through demonstrations at key industry forums, including public safety conferences and technology expos. This work not only contributes to improving emergency response capabilities but also showcases Verizon's commitment to leveraging technology for public safety advancements.

bullets.text: Presented at The Web Conference 2020 (Computer Vision for IoT) and Tech Pulse 2020 (AI Inference Platform). Actively advised four startup cohorts in Verizon's 'Forward For Good' accelerator on their product roadmaps. Led winning internal hackathon teams two years in a row.
bullets.story: I have been an active thought leader within Verizon, presenting at major industry conferences such as The Web Conference 2020 on Computer Vision for IoT and Tech Pulse 2020 on AI Inference Platforms. I have also served as a mentor and advisor for four startup cohorts in Verizon's accelerator program, providing guidance on their product roadmaps and helping them navigate the challenges of bringing innovative solutions to market. Additionally, I led teams that won Verizon's internal hackathon for two consecutive years, demonstrating my ability to foster creativity and drive innovation within the organization. These activities have not only contributed to my personal growth as a technology leader but have also helped to elevate Verizon's profile in the tech community and foster a culture of innovation within the company.

experience.summary: Evangelized AI adoption within Verizon products, identifying key use cases for AI/ML application and created initial prototypes for the product engineering groups to build upon. Collaborating with Verizon's Executive Briefing Centers (EBC), presented Verizon technology advancements to key customer executives.

bullets.text: Designed and deployed ML models for the VZ Cloud product to predict user churn risk, directly influencing retention strategies.
bullets.story: I designed and deployed machine learning models for the Verizon Cloud product to predict user churn risk. I built a data pipeline to ingest and process customer usage data, and developed predictive models that identify patterns indicative of potential churn. The insights generated from these models directly influenced retention strategies, allowing the product team to proactively engage at-risk customers with targeted offers and interventions.

bullets.text: Realized $2M in annual OPEX savings by replacing manual network site selection with a Computer Vision-driven automation engine using satellite and street-view imagery. Pioneered unique algorithms for image stitching and object height detections.
bullets.story:
I led the development of a Computer Vision-driven automation engine that replaced the manual process of network site selection for Verizon. By utilizing satellite and street-view imagery, I designed unique algorithms for image stitching and object height detection to analyze potential sites for network infrastructure deployment. I trained custom computer vision models to identify and classify different types of infrastructure and obstacles, and tuned the models for optimal performance on NVIDIA GPUs. 
This innovation not only improved the accuracy and efficiency of site selection but also resulted in $2M in annual OPEX savings for Verizon by reducing the need for costly manual surveys and enabling faster decision-making.

bullets.text: Engineered accessibility solutions that utilize satellite and street imagery to identify parking spots and curb cuts for handicap driving route services.
bullets.story: I engineered accessibility solutions for smart cities by utilizing satellite and street imagery to identify parking spots and curb cuts for handicap driving route services. I developed computer vision models that analyze imagery to detect and classify accessible parking spaces and curb cuts, providing critical information for navigation services catering to individuals with disabilities. This solution enhances the mobility and independence of users by enabling more accurate and efficient route planning that takes into account accessibility needs.

bullets.text: Secured a Statement of Work (SOW) with Target after winning an exclusive hackathon. Presented the resulting Computer Vision smart-cart solution directly to Target's Board of Directors.
bullets.story: I led a team that won an exclusive hackathon hosted by Target, where we developed a Computer Vision smart-cart solution designed to enhance the in-store shopping experience. The solution utilized off-the-shelf cameras and a custom trained model running on raspberry pi to enable features such as automatic item recognition and real-time inventory tracking. Our innovative approach and successful demonstration of the prototype directly led to securing a Statement of Work (SOW) with Target. I had the opportunity to present our solution directly to Target's Board of Directors, showcasing the potential impact of our technology on their retail operations and customer experience.

bullets.text: Architected a Deep Learning computer vision solution to deliver real-time e-commerce experiences overlaid on linear TV and on-demand content, leading to multiple new product innovations.
bullets.story:
I led the development of a cutting-edge computer vision solution that revolutionized the way e-commerce experiences are delivered on linear TV and on-demand content. This innovation resulted in multiple new product launches and significantly enhanced user engagement. The architecture utilized deep learning models for real-time object recognition and tracking, enabling dynamic overlay of e-commerce content based on the context of the video. I built an inferencing cloud for scalable video processing for hundreds of real-time video streams. I performed CUDA level kernel optimizations on NVIDIA GPUs for custom model training and inference tuning. 
I collaborated closely with product management to define the use cases and worked with the engineering team to implement the solution in a scalable manner. I implemented platform management dashboard using React/NodeJS stack. This initiative not only drove new revenue streams but also positioned Verizon as a leader in next-gen video experiences.

bullets.text: Led the evaluation of CSCF implementations for micro-services applicability, authoring the southbound interface RFI and demonstrating zero-touch provisioning for edge deployment.
bullets.story: I led the evaluation of Call Session Control Function (CSCF) implementations for their applicability to a micro-services architecture. I co-authored the Request for Information (RFI) for the southbound interface, outlining the requirements and expectations for integration with existing network infrastructure. I also demonstrated zero-touch provisioning for edge deployment, showcasing the ability to rapidly deploy and manage network functions at the edge without manual intervention. This work was critical in advancing Verizon's Software-Defined Networking (SDN) strategy and enabling more agile and scalable network architectures.

bullets.text: Architected the flagship K12 communications platform using a .NET/SQL stack, replacing manual paper workflows for schools nationwide. Designed the cloud-native infrastructure on Amazon EC2, including a robust disaster recovery strategy to ensure business continuity.
Delivered native iOS and Android applications and a mobile-optimized web experience, significantly increasing parent engagement rates by 320%.

Led an offshore team of 10 engineers in building a secure, compliant social networking engine for the school community. Features included SIS integration via SAML, granular privacy controls, and secure media sharing.
Established all cloud-based technical operations for a mobile marketing startup.
Engineered and deployed an SMS-based micropayment solution, handling secure transaction processing and gateway integrations, increasing micropayments by 500%.
Directed software development and product operations for a SaaS-based mobile marketing platform.

Led the engineering group in re-architecting the LAMP-based hosted solution to a SaaS model, while including deep social media integration (Facebook/Twitter APIs) and advanced analytics dashboards. This re-architecture resulted in 10x OPEX cost reduction.
Led the professional services division in delivering custom mobile web solutions and iOS applications for enterprise clients, utilizing device-detection logic for optimized content delivery.

Scaled a global engineering organization from 0 to 80+ across the US and India, overseeing the technology integration for a successful corporate merger. Managed complete software development and delivery lifecycle, while also contributing to sales and marketing efforts.

bullets.text: Managed a cross-functional engineering and QA organization of 80 members across three locations (two US sites, one India). Successfully integrated a new US engineering team following a corporate merger.

Directed the release cycles for critical telecom infrastructure products including Session Border Controllers (SBC) and Realtime Session Managers (RSM). Oversaw development of products in multiple tech stacks (embedded Linux, J2EE, Big Data).

Spearheaded the adoption of Agile/Scrum methodologies and continuous test automation. This process overhaul improved productivity and boosted product reliability to 99.999% (5-9s) within 8 months. Designed engineering processes that successfully passed internal TL9000 audits.

Established a new engineering discipline (SRE) to address architectural debt, directly achieving carrier-grade (5-9s) reliability. Led high-impact architectural changes while sustaining product development schedules for 400+ customers. Led the Systems Integration Team to redefine testing methodologies, emphasizing automated load and stress testing for high-volume customer deployments.
Chaired the Product Security Council. Conducted security audits and defined strategies for DoS mitigation and Intrusion Detection/Prevention (IDS/IDP).

Served within the Office of the CTO to conduct technology assessments and define the company's long-term architectural direction. Founding member of the Intellectual Property Committee, leading over 15 patent filings.

patents.title: Biometric based self-sovereign information management based on reverse information search
patents.description: The present teaching relates to method, system, medium, and implementations for authenticating a user. A first request is received to set up authentication information with respect to a user, wherein the first request specifies a type of information to be used for future authentication of the user. It is determined whether the type of information related to the user poses risks based on a reverse information search result. The type of information for being used for future authentication of the user is rejected when the type of information is determined to pose risks.

patents.title: Systems and methods for secure authentication based on machine learning techniques
patents.description: A system described herein may provide a technique for the use of machine learning techniques to perform authentication, such as biometrics-based user authentication. For example, user biometric information (e.g., facial features, fingerprints, voice, etc.) of a user may be used to train a machine learning model, in addition to a noise vector. A representation of the biometric information may be iteratively transformed until the transformed biometric information matches the noise vector, and the machine learning model may be trained based on the set of transformations that ultimately yield the noise vector, when given the biometric information.

patents.title: Systems and methods for low latency cloud computing for mobile applications
patents.description: A device may receive, from a user equipment (UE), a request to allocate one or more computing resources for an application executing on the UE. The device may be associated with an edge node of a mobile network and the UE may be within a coverage area associated with the edge node. The device may receive a remote execution file package that is associated with code to be executed using the one or more computing resources. The device may assign the one or more computing resources for the application and cause installation or execution of the code. The device may transmit a response that provides an indication that the one or more computing resources have been allocated for the application.

patents.title: Biometric based self-sovereign information management
patents.description: The present teaching relates to method, system, medium, and implementations for authenticating a user. An authentication session is first initiated to authenticate, via iris, a person claiming to be an authorized user, in which a first set of signals is randomly generated for controlling light strobing to be applied to the iris of the person for detecting liveness of the iris. A second set of signals is accordingly generated for controlling iris picture capturing synchronized with the light strobing. Whether the person is live is then determined based on the synchronized pictures acquired when the light strobing is applied.

patents.title: Microservices architecture for cloud-scale global navigation satellite system
patents.description: A system can include a producer device to receive reference data from a reference station. The system can include a queue device to store a reference message, corresponding to the reference data, in a message queue. The system can include a mapping device to store mapping information indicating that the message queue is associated with the reference station. The system can include a consumer device to identify the message queue as being associated with a microservice to be provided to a client device based on a microservice request. The consumer device can obtain the reference message from the message queue, generate corrections data associated with the client device, and provide the corrections data.

patents.title: Systems and methods for tracking indoor location of a mobile device
patents.description: A device determines, based on location verification data that has been received, that the device is indoors at a first geographic location. The device determines a base measured barometric pressure, and an initial floor that the device is located on in a structure that includes the first geographic location. The device determines an adjusted measured barometric pressure for a second geographic location based on a second measured barometric pressure and one or more reference barometric pressures. The device determines an altitude for the second geographic location and causes a server to predict a floor that the device is located on at the second geographic location.

patents.title: User device ad-hoc distributed caching of content
patents.description: A device receives a user election of participation in a distributed cache service, and receives user selection of one or more devices, that are each associated with the user, to register with the distributed cache service as participant nodes. The device determines an amount of available storage offered to the cache service and the available bandwidth of a respective network connection for each participant node. The device admits selected devices into the distributed cache service and interleaves storage of multiple chunks of content across a subset of the admitted participant nodes.

patents.title: Object recognition based on hierarchical domain-based models
patents.description: A method, a device, and a non-transitory storage medium each provide an object recognition service that identifies an object within an image or a video. An object is identified according to a general classification based on a domain-based inference model, and is subsequently further identified according to a sub-classification of the general classification based on another domain-based inference model. The domain-based inference models are hierarchical. The object recognition of the object may be used in support of end user services.

patents.title: Blockchain micro-services framework
patents.description: A network device receives a first application programming interface (API) call from an application. The first API call requests a micro-service of a blockchain-based technology. The blockchain-based technology includes use of a shared ledger among participating nodes in a distributed consensus network. The network device sends, in response to the first API call, a second API call to one of the participating nodes, initiating a framework module. The network device receives a response indicating consensus of the participating nodes and generates a reply to the first API call.

patents.title: Native video advertising with voice-based ad management and machine-to-machine ad bidding
patents.description: A method, a device, and a non-transitory storage medium provides storing user preferences pertaining to a native ad service; receiving a program that includes instances of native ad information indicative of instances of native ads; displaying the program; providing the native ad based on the user preferences; determining whether a secondary user device is paired; and transmitting instances of native ad information to the secondary user device in response to determining that the secondary user device is paired.

patents.title: Methods and apparatus for multistage routing of packets using call templates
patents.description: A method for multistage routing of packets using call templates is disclosed. An ingress call is filtered based on a plurality of ingress-call parameter values. A parameter value for the ingress call is modified based on a plurality of ingress-call-peer parameter values. A filtered ingress-call parameter value and at least one filtered ingress-call-peer parameter value are converted to an egress-call parameter value and an egress-call-peer parameter value, respectively. An egress call is filtered based on a plurality of egress-call parameter values.

patents.title: Voice over IP (VoIP) network infrastructure components and method
patents.description: A voice over Internet protocol communication system and method provides infrastructure components as intermediaries between networks, including multi-protocol session controllers and a multi-protocol signaling switch as well as a management system. The session controllers process calls at either the edge of the network or at the core of the VoIP network, associating calls with one another in call peers for incoming calls as ingress call peers and for outgoing calls as egress call peers. A centralized database of call routing policies provides cost management, topology hiding, and inter-working of calls from SIP networks to H.323 networks for both voice and video.

patents.title: Methods and apparatus for forwarding IP calls through a proxy interface
patents.description: A session controller configured to be coupled to a communications network is disclosed. The session controller is configured to receive an indication of a Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) registration request at a first time from an endpoint having a third-party registration, and to receive a signaling message from the endpoint at a second time later than the first time. The session controller is further configured to forward an indication of the VoIP registration request and a signaling message to an application server, such that at least a portion of the topology of the communications network beyond the session controller is hidden to the endpoint.

patents.title: Prioritization within a session over internet protocol (SOIP) network
patents.description: A method includes receiving, at a session controller, session data from a session-detail record. The session data is associated with at least a portion of a call over a Session over Internet Protocol (SoIP) network. A priority indicator associated with an Internet Protocol (IP) packet transmitted over the call is modified at the session controller based on the session data. The priority indicator indicates a priority to transmit the IP packet.

patents.title: Voice over IP (VoIP) network infrastructure components and method
patents.description: A voice over Internet protocol communication system and method provides infrastructure components as intermediaries between networks, including multi-protocol session controllers and a multi-protocol signaling switch as well as a management system. The session controllers process calls and participate in the calls that flow through it, at either the edge of the network or at the core of the VoIP network. A centralized database of call routing policies is provided to the session controllers, enabling cost management, topology hiding, and inter-working of calls from SIP networks to H.323 networks for both voice and video.

patents.title: Methods and apparatus for controlling call admission to a network based on call peers
patents.description: A session controller configured to be coupled to a database and configured to receive an indication associated with an ingress call is disclosed. The session controller is further configured to query the database for an ingress-call peer associated with the ingress call, and to query the database for a dynamic-peer-definition template associated with the ingress call when the ingress-call peer is not identified upon query of the database. The session controller is further configured to reject the ingress call when the dynamic-peer-definition template is not identified upon query of the database.

patents.title: Method and apparatus for partitioning resources within a session-over-internet-protocol (SoIP) session controller
patents.description: A method and apparatus for partitioning resources within a Session-over-Internet-Protocol (SoIP) Session Controller (SC) are described. An apparatus comprises data access logic configured to receive an instruction to define at least one virtual partition in a SoIP SC, grant a primary entity access to data associated with each virtual partition, and grant each secondary entity exclusive access to data associated with a virtual partition associated with that secondary entity. Session administration logic is configured to generate, for each SoIP session traversing a given virtual partition, a session data record uniquely associated with that given virtual partition.

patents.title: Adaptive feedback for session over internet protocol
patents.description: A method includes receiving an instruction associated with a definition of an alarm condition and modifying a session controller associated with a Session over Internet Protocol (SoIP) network based on the alarm condition. The session controller can be modified when the alarm condition, which is defined based on session data, is changed from satisfied to unsatisfied or unsatisfied to satisfied. The modifying of the session controller is associated with a set of connections that includes more than zero connections.

patents.title: Session data records and related alarming within a session over internet protocol (SOIP) network
patents.description: A method and apparatus processes session layer parameters and/or extrinsic parameters with reference to an alarm condition to determine whether a route should be modified. When the alarm condition is either satisfied or unsatisfied, the route can be modified. The session layer parameters and/or extrinsic parameters are contained in a session-data-record.

patents.title: Methods and apparatus for predictive call admission control within a media over internet protocol network
patents.description: A method includes receiving at an ingress session exchange device a call admission control (CAC) condition and a CAC value associated with an endpoint of a first egress session exchange device and CAC-related information associated with an endpoint of a second egress session exchange device. The ingress session exchange device is at a border of a session over internet protocol network. A first call admission calculation is performed to determine whether the CAC condition is satisfied, and a second call admission calculation is performed when the CAC condition is unsatisfied.

patents.title: Methods and apparatus for routing IP media data based on cost
patents.description: A session controller configured to receive a data packet from a packet-switched network having multiple communication links is disclosed. The disclosed session controller is further configured to define a call-routing policy based on layer-five, layer-two, layer-three and layer-seven information from the data packet. The call-routing policy is configured to define a least-cost routing (LCR) call route for an ingress call over at least one of the plurality of communication links. The session controller is also configured to associate the ingress call to an egress-call peer based on the call routing policy.
